report:
**Summary:** You scored 48% against 50% expected over 300 games [F1], and your overall blunder count matched expectation [F2]. The clearest leak is missed discovered attacks, plus a few openings where the evidence is thinner.

## Biggest weaknesses

**1. Missing discovered attacks (pattern).** When you blundered, the better move was a discovered attack 18 times, versus 4 for your opponents in the same games: 4.50 times their rate, 90% interval 1.87 to 10.86 [F22]. Example: 29.Bd7 lost 86 win% when the engine preferred Bf5 [F23] (https://www.chess.com/game/live/187005539854).
*Do:* Drill discovered-attack puzzles [F24]. Before each move, check whether moving a piece opens a line from one of your sliders onto an enemy piece.

**2. Queen's Pawn Opening as White (possible weakness).** You scored 27% against 51% expected [F6]. The position was level after move 12 (median +0.0 pawns) [F12], but in moves 13-25 you lost 5.2 win% per move, versus 5.1 across all your games [F12]. The shrunk gap is -4 points, with an interval of -15 to +3 [F6], so the evidence is limited.
*Do:* Review your games in this opening [F6] and focus on middlegame plans [F28].

**3. Englund Gambit as Black (possible weakness).** You scored 21% against 49% expected in 7 games [F8]. The shrunk gap is -4 points, with an interval of -14 to +3 [F8]. Moves 13-25 cost 4.8 win% per move [F14]. This is thin evidence.

## What's working

- **Time pressure:** With 10-30% of the clock left you made 60 blunders against 82.2 expected (0.73 times, interval 0.58 to 0.91) [F4].
- **Allowing discovered attacks:** Your blunders allowed a discovered attack 6 times, versus 21 for your opponents (0.29 times) [F25].

## Training plan

- Solve discovered-attack puzzles: https://lichess.org/training/discoveredAttack [F24].
- Practise hanging-piece tactics: https://lichess.org/training/hangingPiece [F21]. Your missed hanging pieces are worth watching at 1.75 times your opponents' rate [F19]. Example: 43...Kh7 lost 97 win% when Qxf4+ was best [F15].
- Study middlegame tactics: https://lichess.org/training/middlegame [F28].
- Review your Queen's Pawn and Englund games for the moves after move 12 [F12][F14]. Your 4 Pirc Defense games as White (0%) [F7] are too few to act on yet.
